name: Waveform / loudness
description: Amplitude over time, often with a loudness envelope. The rawest view of the signal.

name: Static spectrogram
description: Time left to right, frequency bottom to top, energy as darkness or colour. Read after the sound has ended.

name: Real-time spectrogram
description: The same picture drawn live while the sound is produced, scrolling past a 'now' edge.

name: Synthetic pseudo-spectrogram
description: Hand-drawn formant bars standing in for speech, so cue position and salience can be controlled.

name: Spectrum slice (LPC) with target
description: One moment's frequency profile, e.g. an LPC curve whose peaks are formants, plus a target marker or template.

name: Pitch contour
description: Fundamental frequency over time, often against a target note.

name: Location display
description: Rings or arrows showing where a sound came from and how loud it was, without pitch.

name: Recognized-sound icon or label
description: A recognizer names the sound; the display shows only the result, e.g. a doorbell icon.

name: Expressive captions
description: Speech-to-text whose typography (size, weight, colour) varies with prosody or emotion.

name: Learned image
description: A neural network maps sound to faces or digits so that similar sounds look alike.

name: Ultrasound of the tongue
description: Shows the tongue, not the sound. Physiological biofeedback is excluded; appears only as a comparison arm.

name: Music animation driven by MIDI
description: Visuals generated from note data rather than audio: abstract particles or video of gestures. Included only when designed for and evaluated with DHH users.

name: Emotion cues (emoji)
description: An emotion model reads the voice; the display shows emoji or similar cues for the recognized emotion.
